description: Renovate owns dependency version updates for this repository. .github/dependabot.yml was removed once it did — PR #232 introduced Renovate to replace Dependabot and the switch was left half-finished, so both bots proposed the same bumps for months.
Dependabot security updates are unaffected: those come from the repository's security settings, not from dependabot.yml, and stay on.

design-mocks/ is excluded below because it is a read-only mirror of github.com/denisvmedia/inventario-design synchronized by an external tool (see AGENTS.md). A bump there would be wiped on the next sync.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch updates only (#2097). Minor and major are held for manual review. Auto-merge waits for branch-protection required checks (go-govulncheck, dependency-review, image scan) via platformAutomerge — those checks are the real gate, not Renovate. minimumReleaseAge adds a soak buffer against freshly-published-and-yanked patches.
Never auto-merge minor or major updates (#2097) — review the changelog and CI results manually.
Volta Node.js and npm version pinning
Disallow major versions update for databases

Vite + bundler ecosystem — never auto-merge. Even patch bumps can quietly swap or update the underlying bundler (rolldown is on a 1.0.0-rc.* line that ships breaking changes between rcs) and surface runtime regressions that lint/typecheck/unit tests can't catch. Driven by a past incident in this repo where a vite 8.x patch bump landed via auto-merge despite an E2E failure on the renovate PR run (see #1427). Manual review + green E2E on the bump PR is required.

go-lint.yml reads the golangci-lint version from the vars action, so the action's `version:` input holds an expression. Renovate already skips it as `invalid-value`; disabling it says so on purpose, and records that the customManager above is what bumps the real pin, so nobody puts a literal back here to 'fix' the skip (#1818).

customManagers.description: The golangci-lint pin lives in the vars action, which go-lint.yml and copilot-setup-steps.yml both read, so it is bumped in one place (#1818).
Chart and tool versions in infra/vm/vm-install.sh are shell variables, which no manager reads. Pinning them made bootstrap reproducible (#1946); this is what keeps them from freezing there.
